f117a21d-250d-4bc9-bcd7-1f0bdca8c115.content: Result: A=S+M*A built from fully pinned blocks S (7 cases, X up to 60000) keeps only the base block pinned; no lifted element is ever pinned. Carry argument: M in 4S whenever 3S covers [0,M). Density crossover: log-size spines cannot be 3-bases past ~10^4, so gap-free SAT chain depth is inconclusive for the infinite problem. Documented in docs/pinned-block-search.md; scripts/probe_pinned_search.py, scripts/probe_pinned_sat.py, docs uncommitted.
